descriptions.en:
An English translation of **Tobit 12**, the chapter *The Book Which Tells the Truth* quotes at 12:19-20: the companion of Tobias reveals that he is Raphael, 'one of the seven holy angels', that 'I neither ate nor drank, but you were seeing a vision', and that he is going up to the one who sent him. The rest of the book is not translated.

Source: the Greek of Swete's Septuagint (1896, Public Domain), the shorter text of Codex Vaticanus (GI), which the canon quotes word for word, from the First1KGreek digital transcription (CC BY-SA 4.0). The notes give the readings of the longer Sinaiticus text (GII).
